doc: View lab (docs/view-lab/PLAN.md): the camera's projection per view id, picked by the launch flag --view=<id> (default `top`, the shipped 90-degree orthographic view, bit-identical: no transform is applied). pitch_deg is the camera's angle above the ground (90 = straight down); the ground plane is foreshortened by sin(pitch) on screen y (Camera2D zoom.y), so the mouse unprojects onto the ground through the same canvas transform. height_k scales how far a part's height lifts it up the screen (cos(pitch), the 2.5D actors; 0 = flat). Render only: a view never writes to the sim. cards (optional, default false) draws the upright facing cards (the head/bust drawn for the raised camera, 5 facings drawn + 3 mirrored, features/characters/art/view/) over the top-down head under a tilt. eye_h_m (optional, top_lift) makes a straight-down view a perspective camera that high above the ground: heights lean away from the screen centre. art (optional, default none) names the cards' art folder for this pitch (features/characters/art/view/<art>/, e.g. p55 = cut from the 55-degree angle sheets: a card file found there replaces the base strip, RigHeadCard.SET_CARDS rows replace whole rows), so each pitch's art sits beside the others. cast_k (optional, default 0) casts a ground shadow per height down-right (RigCastShadows: bodies, King's car, the arena props): its length per unit of height. occlude (optional, default true under a tilt) draws the arena's standing props over a body behind them with the body as an ink silhouette (PropOcclusion); false = the body draws over the prop (the it12 tilt).

views.note: the shipped view: straight down, orthographic, untouched

still 90 degrees, no tilt: a straight-down perspective camera 25 m up (eye_h_m), so the car, the props and the bodies lean out from the screen centre by their heights; cast shadows by height (cast_k 1.2, down-right: a low evening sun)
study: top_lift with the eye 15 m up (stronger lean out from the screen centre)

the main candidate (DECISION it5): 55 degrees with the upright facing cards (Rivet, King, gang, patrol cop); picked from the 65 / 55 / 45 stills at 32 px/m: 65 barely differs from top, 45 squashes the ground to 71 % and the top-down limbs read squat; cast shadows by height (cast_k 1.2, DECISION it12: they ground the car and the bodies on the foreshortened road); d8: art p55 (the facing cards cut from the owner's 55-degree angle sheets, art/view/p55/: Rivet's bust)
study (d8 before): tilt with the n7 base cards (no art: Rivet's head-only card)
pitch study: 65 degrees, no cards (the it2 `tilt`)
pitch study: 45 degrees, the stronger three-quarter end of the range
tilt 65 with the upright facing cards (Rivet head, King bust)
tilt 55 with the upright facing cards
tilt 45 with the upright facing cards
study: tilt (55 + cards) without the cast shadows (the it9 tilt)
study: tilt without the prop occlusion (a body behind a barrier draws over it; the it12 tilt)
lane d8-view70: the tilt row's switches (cards, cast shadows, occlusion) at 70 degrees, with the 70-degree card art (art p70: features/characters/art/view/p70/, else the base card)

lane d8-view70, the combined view: 70 degrees in play (art p70), easing to boss_pitch_deg 55 over ease_s when a boss engages (Events.boss_engaged) and back to 70 when it is defeated (ViewPitchEase; eased on sim ticks, so it holds during a hit-stop); the cards cross-fade from the p70 to the base (55) art over fade_deg centred on swap_deg (fade_deg 0 = a hard swap)
